# Bluarc Labs

> Bluarc Labs is an industrial technology company based in India. It works on OT (operational technology) security, Industry 4.0 and plant analytics, and embedded hardware and sensing for industrial plants.

- Website: https://bluarclabs.com/
- Contact: founder@bluarclabs.com

## Focus areas

- Industrial (OT) security: protecting the computers that run production, such as operator stations, engineering workstations and plant-floor PCs, where standard IT security tools don't fit.
- Industry 4.0 and plant analytics: condition monitoring, plant analytics and predictive maintenance.
- Embedded hardware and sensing: wireless sensing and instrumentation for harsh industrial environments.

## Products

- SAFE by Bluarc Labs: security for industrial computers. In development.
